While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
工作内容：
1、负责腾讯云日本市场的业务拓展与销售达成，统筹渠道生态与直销双线推进，完成年度销售业绩目标；
2、渠道线：围绕核心渠道伙伴（含大型系统集成商/SI，如NTT DATA、CTC、TIS等），对齐战略方向及销售目标，制定渠道增长计划，推动伙伴赋能、培训认证、激励政策及商机转化落地；
3、直销线：独立负责日本市场头部客户（含大型企业、互联网公司及政企客户）的开拓与攻坚，主导全销售周期——从客户识别、需求洞察、方案设计到商务谈判与签约落地；
4、建立并维护与重点渠道伙伴及直销客户的长期合作关系，构建稳定的客户沟通及经营复盘机制，持续深耕客户价值，推动增购与交叉销售；
5、制定日本区域的策略方案，系统性拓展新合作伙伴及直销目标客户，管理完整的销售Pipeline，持续推动新商机的挖掘与转化；
6、整合公司内部资源（产品、解决方案、售前、交付等），推动解决渠道伙伴及直销客户在销售转化中的关键问题，持续优化销售流程与客户体验；
7、跟踪日本云计算市场动态及策略，输出市场洞察，为业务决策及产品本地化提供一线输入。
仕事内容

2.チャネル：NTT DATA、CTC、TISなどの大手システムインテグレーター（SI）を含む中核パートナーを中心に、戦略方向性および売上目標をすり合わせ、チャネル成長計画を策定。パートナーの育成（イネブルメント）、研修・認定、インセンティブ政策、商談転換の着地を推進する。
3.ダイレクトセールス：日本市場の大手顧客（大手企業、インターネット企業、官公庁・企業顧客を含む）の開拓・深耕を単独で担当。顧客の特定、ニーズ把握、提案設計から商談交渉、契約着地まで、セールス全工程をリードする。
4.キーチャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客との長期的な協力関係を構築・維持し、安定した顧客コミュニケーションおよび運営振返りの仕組みを構築。継続的に顧客価値を深耕し、増枠購入およびクロスセルの推進を図る。
5.日本地域の戦略を策定し、体系的に新規パートナーおよびダイレクトセールス目標顧客を拡大。完全なセールスパイプラインを管理し、新規商談の発掘と転換を継続的に推進する。
6.社内リソース（製品、ソリューション、プリセールス、デリバリー等）を統合し、チャネルパートナーおよびダイレクトセールス顧客がセールス転換において直面する肝要課題の解決を推進し、セールスプロセスおよび顧客体験を継続的に最適化する。
7.日本クラウドコンピューティング市場の動向および競合戦略を追跡し、市場インサイトをアウトプット。ビジネス意思決定および製品のローカライゼーションに現場のインプットを提供する。

応募資格/Who We Look For
能力要求
1、本科及以上学历，5年以上云计算或ICT行业销售经验，同时具备渠道拓展与直销/大客户销售实战经验；
2、熟悉日本云计算市场及商业生态，具备与大型系统集成商（SI）合作经验（如NTT DATA、CTC、TIS、SCSK、日立系等），同时有日本大型企业/政企客户直销经验者优先，理解其采购决策流程及组织架构；
3、对云计算产品、解决方案及行业应用有深入理解，具备完整的端到端销售闭环经验（渠道及直销均可），有千万级以上 deal 签约的成功案例；
4、具备强烈的目标导向和猎人思维（Hunter Mindset），自我驱动，能在资源有限的新市场从0到1开拓业务；
5、具备优秀的商务谈判能力、跨团队协调能力及执行力，能够在多方协同环境中主导复杂销售项目落地；
6、具备主流云厂商（如AWS、Azure、GCP、腾讯云等）相关经验或认证者优先，熟练使用数据分析及AI工具者优先；具备AI产品销售经验者优先
7、可接受日本国内及跨国出差
能力要件

4.強い目標志向およびハンター・マインドセット（Hunter Mindset）を有し、自走できること。リソースが限られた新規市場において、0→1のビジネス開拓を遂行できること。

6.主流クラウドベンダー（AWS、Azure、GCP、腾讯云等）の関連経験または認定を有する者を優遇。データ分析およびAIツールの熟練使用者、AI製品セールス経験者を優遇。

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
Responsibilities
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails
About Tencent
Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.
We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a start-up with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.
About the Role
As an HR Compliance Associate supporting our Asia Pacific business, you will help ensure that Tencent's people practices meet local employment legislation, statutory obligations and internal governance standards, with a primary focus on Singapore. Working closely with HR colleagues, business leaders and regional stakeholders, you will support employment compliance, HR governance and employee relations casework across a multi-country region, building deep and practical expertise in employment regulation in one of Asia Pacific's most closely regulated markets.
Responsibilities
Support compliance with employment legislation and statutory requirements, with a primary focus on Singapore, including the Employment Act, the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act and Ministry of Manpower regulations; partner with country HR colleagues to track regulatory developments and help translate changes into practical process updates.
Support employee relations casework under the guidance of senior HR and Legal colleagues, including case intake and triage, evidence and document collation, interview scheduling and note-taking, timeline construction, case file maintenance and follow-up tracking, exercising strict confidentiality, neutrality and consistency of process throughout.
Serve as a point of support for employee relations and employment compliance enquiries escalated from employees, managers and HR Business Partners, facilitating resolution and partnering with the business, HR, Legal and other stakeholders to deliver fair and consistent outcomes.
Ensure employment documentation and HR records are audit standard, covering employment contracts, Key Employment Terms, policy acknowledgements, disciplinary and grievance records, personnel files and retention schedules, ensuring records are complete, accurate and defensible under review.
Support internal and external audits, labour compliance reviews and HR governance activities by assembling evidence, reconciling records against source systems, tracking remediation actions through to closure and documenting outcomes.
Support the periodic review, risk assessment and rollout of HR policies across the region, working with legal advisors to ensure local policies remain aligned to both Tencent global standards and country-specific legal requirements.
Build and maintain the employee relations and policy knowledge repository, and support the development of manager training materials on fair employment practices, grievance handling and proper documentation.
Identify control gaps and propose practical improvements, including better use of HR case management and workflow systems to reduce manual handling and strengthen compliance tracking.

Who We Look For
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Law, Psychology or a related discipline.
Approximately 1–3 years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, employee relations or employment compliance. Outstanding fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are also encouraged to apply.
Familiarity with Singapore employment legislation and fair employment practices is a strong advantage. A genuine interest in employment regulation and the willingness to build real depth in this area is essential.
High emotional intelligence and interpersonal maturity, with the ability to handle sensitive situations with professionalism, confidentiality and empathy, and to build trust with employees and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.
Analytical and meticulous, able to conduct precise fact-gathering, maintain accurate records and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a strong sense of accountability, integrity and discretion, and the discipline to meet deadlines and produce work that withstands audit scrutiny.
Comfortable working with HR systems and data, able to build and maintain trackers and case records, reconcile information across sources and use technology to improve operational efficiency.
An initiative-taking communicator who keeps stakeholders well informed, asks questions, flags risks early and takes ownership beyond assigned responsibilities in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.

Responsible for building the full-chain risk management framework for the company's overseas businesses, covering end-to-end business lifecycle management and dynamic risk control. The role requires deep understanding of international AML regulatory frameworks (FATF Recommendations, Singapore MAS, Hong Kong HKMA, EU AMLD, US BSA/AML, etc.), leading the design and implementation of core risk control functions including due diligence, risk rating, and suspicious transaction monitoring, ensuring the company's overseas operations maintain continuous compliance across all jurisdictions while scaling rapidly.Risk Control Framework: Enhance the AML risk control framework covering pre-event, in-event, and post-event stages; drive the implementation of systematic and automated risk control capabilities to ensure end-to-end risk management.

Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination skills; able to align business, product, technology, and operations teams to implement risk control requirements.

岗位职责：
部署紹介/Business Unit
全世界で12億人以上のユーザーを誇る WeChat は、中国と世界中の人々、サービス、企業をつなぎ、モバイルの未来を大きく変革しています。海外市場で WeChat Pay として知られる Weixin Pay は、2013年にWeixinによって導入されたモバイル決済ソリューションです。銀行口座と Weixin Pay アカウントを連携させることで、ユーザーは迅速かつ便利で、安全な決済や取引をスムーズに完了できます。
中国国内では、Weixin Pay は日常生活のあらゆる場面に溶け込み、オンラインまたはオフラインを問わず、小売、飲食、交通、ヘルスケア、レジャーといったさまざまな分野で、効率的かつスマートな決済サービスを提供しています。日本においては、WeChat Pay チームが日本市場全体でのサービス拡大に尽力しています。
With over 1.2 billion users worldwide, WeChat is changing the mobile landscape by connecting people, services, and businesses in China and around-the world. Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner.
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
- ビジネスオペレーション（Business Operations）：Business Development（BD）チームと連携し、顧客関係の強化およびビジネス機会の開拓を推進。
- Key Account（KA）加盟店・機関と連携し、導入、販促物、キャンペーン施策等の推進を行う。
- 市場調査（Market Research）：以下を含むが、これらに限定されない。A. 店舗巡回（Store Inspection）：オフライン店舗を訪問し、販促物の設置状況を確認。B. 市場動向調査（Market Dynamics）：オンライン調査、業界レポート、現地訪問を通じて重要な市場情報を定期的に収集し、決済エコシステムの健全性を評価・比較。C. ユーザー調査（User Research）：現地訪問やオンラインアンケートを通じて、ユーザー浸透率およびユーザー体験に関するデータを収集。
- 販促物展開（Material Deployment）：機関側ではカバーが難しいエリアやシーンに対して、現地での販促物設置を実施。
- 協業開拓（Collaboration Exploration）：大学サークルや主要商業エリア等との連携を推進し、ユーザーコミュニティ向けマーケティング浸透を実施。現地で消費行動を観察し、調査・データ分析を行いながら、WeChatエコシステム内での協業機会を探索。

応募資格/Who We Look For
- 優れたコミュニケーション能力を持ち、積極的かつ熱意のある性格。中国語・日本語ともに流暢で、本社メンバーや海外ステークホルダーとの円滑な連携が可能
- 高いプロジェクトマネジメントおよび実行力を有し、質の高いサマリー・分析レポートを作成可能
- 高い主体性とセルフマネジメント能力を持ち、自律的かつ積極的に業務を推進・完遂できる
- WeChatおよびWeChat Payのプロダクトエコシステムへの理解がある

About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
1. Holistic Product Ownership: Lead the overall direction and vision for the corresponding casual game product. Develop clear product roadmaps and upgrade strategies to ensure creative implementation from 0 to 1 and sustained iterative growth from 1 to N, achieving generational leaps for the product.
2. R&D Coordination & Management: Establish and optimize the game R&D pipeline. Define development milestones and schedules, coordinating efficient collaboration among functional teams including design, art, and engineering. Establish cross-team communication mechanisms and processes to ensure smooth information flow and efficient decision-making, delivering development goals on time with high quality.
3. Quality & Schedule Accountability: Oversee key development milestones and final product quality. Take responsibility for product quality, schedule, and budget. Proactively identify and resolve project risks and bottlenecks to ensure on-time launches and meet expected user satisfaction and business goals.
4. External Partnership Management: As required by projects, lead or participate in co-development and outsourcing management with overseas partner studios. Ensure cross-cultural teams collaborate towards common goals and deliver high-quality content (if opportunities arise for co-development with internationally renowned game companies, proactive coordination and communication are required to ensure smooth cooperation).

Who We Look For
1. Industry Experience: 10+ years of experience in game development, with 3+ years in a core Producer/Product Lead role, deeply involved in the mobile casual games domain.
2. Full-Cycle Ownership & Management: Excellent project management and coordination skills. Capable of leading product development from 0 to 1 through to version evolution from 1 to N and LiveOps, taking full responsibility for product quality and schedule throughout. Familiar with agile development processes, able to define clear milestones and drive the team to achieve them.
3. Strategic Mindset: Deeply understand user acquisition channels and product growth mechanisms in the overseas mobile game market. Familiar with UA buying, marketing, and monetization strategies. Possess a data-driven mindset, skilled at guiding product iteration through A/B testing and user data to improve key metrics (retention, LTV, etc.).
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and coordination skills, capable of bridging different departments such as product, R&D, and operations. Collaborate closely with functional teams like UA, Publishing, Marketing, and Monetization to ensure alignment between product development and market strategies.
5. Candidates with experiences in casual e-sports or casual runner games experiences will be preferred.
6. Fluency in spoken English is preferred.

Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Core Objective:
Drive commercialization growth for Tencent’s overseas performance advertising business across EMEA markets. Own both demand-side advertiser growth and supply-side publisher monetization, accelerating revenue scale, improving ecosystem efficiency, and building scalable commercialization solutions across the region.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Develop and Execute Commercialization Strategy: Identify key opportunities across EMEA market and develop scalable commercialization strategies. Drive growth across both advertiser spend (demand-side) and inventory monetization (supply-side), delivering measurable improvements in revenue, scale, and platform efficiency.
2. Build Scalable Industry Solutions: Translate advertiser and publisher insights into actionable product and operational improvements. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to enhance platform capabilities, improve system efficiency, and develop scalable, competitive industry solutions and best practices that can be replicated across markets and verticals.
3. Drive Customer Acquisition with Sales Teams: Partner closely with Sales to execute growth strategies for both advertisers and publishers. Support opportunity qualification, solution design, and deal execution to improve conversion efficiency and accelerate regional business expansion.
4. Own Client Success and Monetization Outcomes: Manage end-to-end success for both advertisers and publishers across EMEA. Drive performance improvements through product adoption, optimization strategies, and operational support, ensuring long-term business success and value creation for both clients and the platform.

Who We Look For
1. Experience: 2+ years of experience in performance advertising, ad tech, commercialization, client solutions, or growth operations. Experience with ad platforms, DSP/SSP, ad networks, or mobile performance advertising is strongly preferred.
2. Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including demand-side advertising (campaign performance, ROI optimization) and supply-side monetization (inventory yield, fill rate, eCPM). Familiar with performance-driven advertising models and optimization frameworks.
3. Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset. Ability to translate data into actionable business insights. Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and execution skills. High ownership and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.
4. Professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin is required to support day-to-day collaboration with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and the review of business documentation. Additional language capabilities, such as French, German, Spanish, or Arabic, would be considered an advantage.
5. Others: Comfortable working across multiple time zones and managing regional travel as needed. Strong adaptability to ambiguity and changing priorities. Entrepreneurial mindset with strong bias for action, impact, and scalability.

jobs.description:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap a
jobs.requirementText:
岗位要求详情请见上方岗位职责内说明

岗位职责：
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a senior game development expert with deep AAA production experience to strengthen co-development and technical partnership between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios.
The successful candidate will bring a strong technical art and animation background, with a particular focus on asset production and animation workflows. Instead of covering the full breadth of art disciplines, this role concentrates on AI-enabled asset creation, asset performance optimisation, asset visual fidelity and on the animation side skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.Participate in co-development projects between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios, providing senior expertise in AI-enabled asset production, asset performance optimisation, asset visual quality, skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.
Make AI-driven asset and animation improvement a central pillar of technical collaboration. Identify concrete opportunities across the full asset lifecycle (modelling, texturing, materials, LODs, performance profiling) and animation disciplines (skeleton generation, skinning, control rigs, cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics and ragdoll setups).
Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept projects that integrate AI tools with existing asset authoring tools, animation rigging environments, physics engines, and Unreal Engine or equivalent game engines.
Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.
Drive the transition of successful AI experiments into daily production workflows. Collect user feedback, refine asset and animation pipelines, and document repeatable implementation approaches for asset generation, optimisation, rigging automation and physics setup.
Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.
Document reusable AI use cases, asset pipeline standards, rigging and physics best practices, performance guidelines and evaluation methods. Share knowledge through workshops, technical reviews and project retrospectives.
Monitor trends in generative AI, neural rendering, procedural content generation, machine learning for deformation and physics, digital humans and real-time graphics, assessing their practical value for AAA asset and animation production.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Graphics, Digital Media, Game Development, Art and Design, Animation, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
At least 8 years of professional experience in technical art, animation technology or a closely related discipline, with significant exposure to AAA asset and animation pipelines.
Experience operating as a Senior Technical Artist, Lead Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, Animation Pipeline Lead, Rigging Lead or equivalent senior role with a clear focus on assets and/or animation.
Proven development experience on a recognised AAA game project, including at least one shipped AAA title where you were directly responsible for asset optimisation, rigging, or physics-animation workflows.
Strong understanding of the complete AAA asset and animation lifecycle, from initial modelling and rigging, through version control and validation, to engine integration, performance profiling and runtime optimisation.
Strong interest in generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, especially as applied to asset generation, asset optimisation, auto-rigging, motion synthesis, deformation prediction and physics simulation.
Ability to identify high-value AI opportunities rooted in real asset and animation production challenges and progress them through proof-of-concept, workflow design, tool integration and production adoption.
Strong experience with Unreal Engine or another major game engine, including real-time rendering, asset management, animation blueprints, physics assets and cross-platform performance constraints.
Proficiency in Blender or Maya; working knowledge of Houdini is a plus.
Experience with tools development or workflow automation using Python, C++, Blueprint or equivalent, particularly for asset processing, rigging automation or physics pipeline tools.
Strong problem-solving, solution design and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance asset quality, animation expressiveness, engineering feasibility and production efficiency.
Excellent English communication skills, able to lead technical discussions, conduct solution reviews, prepare documentation and collaborate effectively in an international environment.
Willingness to work across regions and time zones and to travel to partner studios in Europe or other locations when required.

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:
​​(1) AAA asset production pipelines (characters, environments, props) with a strong emphasis on performance optimisation, memory budgets, LOD strategies and visual consistency.
(2) Asset visual quality and efficiency: material authoring, texture optimisation, shading models, draw call management and cross-platform asset validation.
(3) Skeleton design and character/creature rigging: hierarchical structures, joint placement, modular rig systems, and auto-rigging methods.
(4) Skinning and deformation: linear blend skinning, dual quaternion skinning, corrective blendshapes, muscle systems and deformation quality control.
(5) Physics-based animation: cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics, ragdoll setups, secondary motion, and real-time physics constraints in engine.

Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world. We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
パブリッシング プロデューサーは、担当スタジオと連携し、高品質なグローバルパブリッシング戦略を推進することが役割です。本ポジションは、データ分析を踏まえたGTM（Go-To-Market）戦略、インサイト、オペレーション構築・リソース管理、クロスファンクショナル連携、そしてキャンペーン運営の卓越性を組み合わせたものです。
この役割では、スタジオのリーダーシップと直接連携し、パブリッシングロードマップの策定、Tencent のグローバル基準との整合性の確保、パブリッシングの優先順位の設定、そしてマーケティング、コンテンツ、商業戦略、リサーチ、プラットフォームなど広範な領域で遂行の支援を行います。
理想的な候補者は、戦略的思考、分析力、構造的なアプローチ、高い協働力を兼ね備え、複数市場でのゲームパブリッシング、複雑なクロスリージョン環境、そしてパブリッシングプロセスの実務経験を有する方です。スタジオパートナーシップ
明確で具体的な価値を継続的に提供することで、スタジオとの強い信頼関係を構築する。
スタジオリーダーの戦略的パートナーとして実務的な助言を行い、透明性のあるコミュニケーションを提供し、Tencent のリソースにつなぐ役割を担う。
パブリッシング戦略
スタジオと共にグローバルパブリッシング戦略とワークフローを共同リードする。
パブリッシングの準備状況、GTM 方向性、マーケティングアプローチを体系的に評価する。
Tencent のグローバル機能をスタジオのパイプラインに統合する。
長期的なパブリッシング計画を明確な責任範囲と意思決定プロセスとともに整合させる。
GTM & キャンペーンリード
ポジショニング、セグメンテーション、コンテンツロードマップ、KPI、キャンペーン構造などGTM 立案をリードする。
インサイトチームと連携し、リサーチ、競合分析、プレイテスト、データに基づく提案を GTM の基盤として取り入れる。
クリエイティブアセットや拡散戦略のレビューと検証を行う。
スタジオのパブリッシング計画を広げるためのビジネス機会やパートナーシップを特定する。
キャンペーンの KPI を追跡し、ライフサイクル全体を通じて最適化案を提示する。
オペレーション & クロスファンクショナル調整
スタジオ内および Tencent リソース間のマーケティング、コンテンツ、コミュニティ、PR、商業、プラットフォームなどのチームとの整合を推進する。
効率的なパブリッシングワークフローとレポーティング体制をスタジオと共に確立する。
ROI とマイルストーンに基づいた予算運用の効率性を評価する。
Tencent チームとスタジオリーダーシップの間で、パブリッシング関連の明確なコミュニケーションを促進する。
市場 & パフォーマンス評価
グローバルパブリッシングに関連する市場動向、プラットフォームの変化、競合の動きを監視し、スタジオを知見で支援する。
プロダクト品質、ゲームプレイの完成度、ユーザーの反応を評価し、改善提案につなげる。
リーダーシップ & メンタリング
スタジオ、外部パートナー、Tencent チームと強く協働的な関係を構築する。
パブリッシング担当者を指導し、スタジオおよび Tencent のパブリッシング水準の向上に貢献する。

応募資格/Who We Look For
経験・専門性： 
ゲームパブリッシング、GTM、またはスタジオ支援業務における 12 年以上の経験。 パブリッシング戦略、インサイト、クリエイティブ／コンテンツ、商業、プラットフォームなどグローバルパブリッシングフレームワークの深い理解。

 協働的で柔軟、プロアクティブかつ戦略と実務のバランスを持った方。

What the Role Entails
1. Migration Architecture Design & Hands-on Implementation:
Design architecture migration solutions for public cloud customers. Focus on deep technical implementation for migrating overseas mainstream stacks (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) to Tencent Cloud WeData + DLC/EMR (storage-compute separation architecture). Deploy migration environments, execute data synchronization, and perform business cutovers on the front line.

Coordinate internal and external resources to overcome organizational and technical barriers, ensuring the successful final delivery of the migration project.

Ensure a fast and smooth transition to the cloud by managing data consistency, business continuity, and providing comprehensive technical guidance.

Product-Research Collaboration & Best Practices: Work closely with Solution Architects (SA) to professionally summarize and feed back real-world customer requirements, pain points, and tool defects. Assist SAs in refining migration roadmaps and co-authoring "Best Practice Manuals" for migrating from overseas cloud platforms to Tencent Cloud.

3. System Analysis & Large-scale Management: Strong capability in system problem analysis and resolving complex architectural issues. Proven experience in cluster performance tuning, troubleshooting, source code optimization, and version upgrades; experience managing large-scale clusters (1000+ nodes) is preferred.
4. Migration Delivery Experience: Extensive experience in Big Data migration implementation and management. Master common migration workflows and methodologies for big data components. Familiar with mainstream vendor platforms and a proven track record of delivering large-scale cloud migration projects (PB-level).
5. Core Component Principles: Deep understanding of the Hadoop ecosystem, with source-code level or deep tuning experience in HDFS, Yarn, Spark, Hive, Flink, Doris, Iceberg/Hudi, etc. Capable of handling underlying compatibility issues in heterogeneous environments.
6. Soft Skills & Professionalism: Excellent customer service awareness, communication, and resource coordination skills. Proactive, self-driven, and highly responsible. Able to thrive under pressure in cross-cloud and overseas migration scenarios.

What the Role Entails
About Tencent
Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen, China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.
We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. We offer a range of services such as cloud computing, advertising, FinTech, and other enterprise services to support our clients' digital transformation and business growth.
We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward.

Job Overview
Tencent is seeking a seasoned communications specialist to drive the global communications strategy primarily for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, and secondarily support Tencent's corporate communications across Northeast Asiaa market.

This is a strategic, high-impact role for a communications professional who can blend cultural fluency, strategic rigor, and creative instinct to shape how Tencent Games in global market. You will be the in-market communications partner for our portfolio of world-class studios and titles, the steward of regional media relationships, and a key advisor to global and regional leadership on reputation, narrative, and market dynamics.

The role is based in Tokyo or Seoul. You will report on a solid line to the Head of Tencent Games Global Communications, and on a dotted line to the Head of Tencent APAC Corporate Communications, working at the intersection of Tencent Games' global
comms function and Tencent's broader corporate reputation agenda in the region.● Define and own the communications strategy for Tencent Games and game titles in Northeast Asia market, translating global priorities into locally resonant strategy and narratives that build relevance, trust, and player affinity.
● Drive communications for Tencent Games' portfolio — including published titles and partner studios — across the full product lifecycle in in Northeast Asia market.
● Partner across studios, publishing, marketing, legal, compliance, public affairs, and global comms peers to deliver integrated, well-aligned communications strategy.
● Manage PR agency partners and coordinate with internal stakeholders to drive quality execution, effective resource allocation and measurable communications outcomes.
● With a primary focus on coordinating and executing media communications plans for Tencent's game business in Japan and Korea, including the planning and execution of media events such as press briefings, exhibitions, open days, media tours and executive engagements.
● Support communications needs across Tencent's business groups, namely social communications, digital content, payment, enterprise solutions, in Northeast Asia.
● Build and maintain relationships with the media and relevant external partners to support Tencent's game business and and other business groups, corporate reputation effort in Japan and Korea.
● Lead local content planning and contribution for Tencent's owned channels in Japan and Korea, including social media platforms, websites, newsletters and other corporate communications materials, as well as gather and localize content from internal teams to ensure locally relevant messaging across channels.
● Monitor local media landscape, industry trends and public sentiment, and support issues management and crisis communications in Japan and Korea, working closely with Game Global Comms team/APAC Corporate Communications, business teams, legal and policy teams where needed.

Who We Look For
● 5+ years of experience in PR, corporate communications, or media relations, ideally with meaningful experience at a global company or top-tier international communications agency.
● Solid, hands-on craft across the core PR disciplines — strategy and messaging development, executive and editorial writing, media pitching and event execution, issues and crisis management, spokesperson preparation, and reputation management.
● Demonstrated track record of leading in-market communications and media relations in Japan, with strong existing relationships in the Japanese media landscape.
● Native or near-native Japanese or Korean, written and verbal.
● Fluent Chinese (Mandarin) and/or English — at least one is required at a working professional level.
● Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, cross-time-zone organization.
● Bachelor's degree or higher in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
Preferred
● a video gamer.
● Prior PR / communications experience in the video games or technology industry.

We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist to help build AI-powered capabilities for our influencer marketing platform. You will work at the intersection of data science, product, and engineering, helping bring intelligent systems into real world use cases that drive measurable business impact.

Work on use cases such as: 
Creator segmentation and recommendation.
Creator Content labeling and data analysis.

Agentic Systems Developing.

Translate business and product problems into data science solutions.
Design experiments to validate hypotheses and measure impact.
Iterate on models based on performance, feedback, and real-world usage.

3. Data Pipeline & Feature Engineering
Work with data engineers to define and build scalable data pipelines.
Clean, process, and structure large datasets (creator data, content metadata, campaign performance).
Design meaningful features that improve model performance.

4. Product Integration
Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to integrate models into the platform.
Ensure models are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.
Contribute to API design, model serving, and inference workflows.

5. Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
Track model performance using appropriate metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, business KPIs).
Maintain documentation and ensure reproducibility.

Core Values
Integrity – You prioritize correctness, transparency, and responsible use of data.
Gamer Native – You understand gaming ecosystems and player/content dynamics.
Pop Culture Fluent – You are familiar with creators, platforms, and digital trends.
Tech-Savvy – You are curious and hands-on with emerging AI technologies.

Technical Skills
Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics.
Proficiency in Python and common ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch,scikit-learn).
Experience with data processing (e.g., pandas, SQL).
Familiarity with LLMs, NLP, or recommendation systems is a strong plus.
Understanding of model deployment (APIs, batch/real-time inference) is preferred.

Data & Product Thinking
Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into data science solutions.
Strong analytical thinking and hypothesis-driven approach.
Understanding of how models create value in a product context (not just offline metrics).

Execution & Collaboration
Ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and business teams.
Good communication skills—able to explain complex models in simple terms.
Strong ownership and ability to iterate quickly.

Nice to Have
Experience in influencer marketing, advertising, or creator platforms.
Familiarity with social media data (e.g., YouTube, Twitch, TikTok ecosystems).
Experience with embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval systems.
Basic knowledge of data engineering or MLOps workflows.

Example Projects You Might Work On
Build a creator discovery engine using embeddings + similarity search.
Develop a content understanding pipeline (tags, sentiment, brand safety).
Train a campaign ROI prediction model to guide budget allocation. 
Integrate LLMs to improve tool efficiency and automate workflows.

岗位职责：
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is looking for a results-oriented and commercially astute Senior Strategic Sales Executive to drive cloud adoption across the broader internet sector, including fast-growing digital-native businesses, platforms, and cross-border internet enterprises. This role is ideal for someone who understands the fast-evolving dynamics of internet clients and can connect Tencent Cloud’s infrastructure, security, and platform solutions to their technical and commercial needs. You will play a key role in expanding our presence across regional markets by managing complex deal cycles, engaging senior stakeholders, and shaping scalable growth strategies.
Responsibilities
Acquire and grow strategic internet accounts across social, gaming, e-commerce, media, and other digital-native verticals.
Build trusted relationships with C-level decision-makers, product owners, and engineering leaders to position Tencent Cloud as a long-term strategic partner.
Understand the unique infrastructure, compliance, and performance demands of internet workloads; match those needs with Tencent Cloud’s IaaS, PaaS, and security product offerings.
Work closely with internal cross-functional teams including pre-sales, product, engineering, and legal to shape solution proposals and close complex deals.
Develop region-specific go-to-market strategies informed by market intelligence, industry trends, and platform-specific requirements.
Represent Tencent Cloud at industry forums and client workshops to elevate product visibility and deepen client engagement.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of cloud solution sales experience, preferably with internet clients or digital-native enterprises.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, content delivery, security architecture, and scaling considerations typical in internet-facing applications.
Demonstrated success in engaging and influencing both technical (e.g., CTOs, engineers) and business (e.g., product leads, GMs) stakeholders.
Fluency in English and Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with regional teams and clients.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership, adaptability, and collaborative spirit in a high-growth, cross-cultural setting.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。
柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。
LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
・ゲーム内レベルデザインの設計・構築
ステージ構造、敵の配置、ギミック、導線、探索要素などを含むゲーム内のプレイ空間を設計し、プレイヤーの体験を演出します。
・難易度曲線と進行設計
ゲームの序盤から終盤にかけての難易度の変化や学習曲線を意識し、プレイヤーが自然にスキルアップできるようにステージ構成を調整します。
・ナラティブやシステムとの整合性の確保
ストーリー展開やゲームシステムと整合性を持たせながら、シームレスに進行するレベル体験を設計します。
・プレイテストとレベルチューニング
ユーザーテストや開発中のプレイを通じて、レベル構成の面白さ・導線の分かりやすさ・テンポ感などを検証し、継続的に改善します。
・ツールを用いたマップ作成と実装作業
エンジン内ツールやレベルエディタを使用して、実際のマップ作成・配置を行い、仕様を実装まで担当します。
Job Description
・Design and Construction of In-Game Level Layouts Plan and create gameplay spaces that include stage structures, enemy placement, gimmicks, player routes, and exploration elements, crafting engaging experiences for players.
・Difficulty Curve and Progression Design Adjust stage compositions to ensure a natural learning curve and smooth skill progression from the beginning to the end of the game.
・Ensuring Narrative and System Consistency Design seamless level experiences that align with story progression and game systems.
・Playtesting and Level Tuning Conduct user tests and in-development play sessions to verify the fun factor, clarity of routes, and pacing of levels, making continuous improvements based on feedback.
・Map Creation and Implementation Using Tools Use in-engine tools and level editors to create maps, place objects, and handle implementation in accordance with specifications.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件 
・コンソール・PC向けゲームにおけるレベルデザインの実務経験 ・空間構成力およびプレイヤー体験を考慮したステージ設計スキル
・プレイテストに基づくチューニング力（テンポ、難易度、導線など）
・ゲームエンジン（Unreal Engine、Unityなど）を用いたレベル作成経験 ・開発チームと連携するための仕様書作成・説明能力
・戦闘・成長・探索など他システムとの連携を意識したレベル構築の視点 歓迎スキル
・3Dアクションゲームにおける空間設計の経験 ・スクリプトやトリガーを用いたイベント演出の構築経験
・カメラや演出の知識を活かしたシネマティックなレベル設計 ・多国籍チームとの共同開発経験
Qualifications
・Proven experience in level design for console and/or PC games
・Strong spatial composition skills and the ability to design stages with player experience in mind
・Ability to fine-tune gameplay based on playtest results (e.g., pacing, difficulty, player guidance)
・Experience creating levels using game engines such as Unreal Engine or Unity
・Skill in creating and explaining specifications for effective cross-team collaboration ・Understanding of how to design levels that integrate seamlessly with systems such as combat, progression, and exploration Preferred Skills
・Experience in spatial design for 3D action games
・Ability to create event-driven experiences using scripting and triggers
・Knowledge of cameras and visual direction for cinematic level design
・Experience working on development projects with multinational teams

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
1. 製品の要件やアーキテクチャを分析し、テスト方法およびテストケースの設計を担当します。
2. 製品の機能、システム性能、プラットフォームの互換性、APIインターフェースのテストなどのテスト業務を担当し、製品運用中に品質問題を発見、収集、明確化し、それらの解決を推進および追跡します。
3. 同種製品の分析、安定性分析、システム信頼性などの特定テスト業務を担当し、具体的なテスト活動の計画と実施を行います。
4. ゲーム製品における自動化および継続的インテグレーション（CI）の構築を企画・推進し、テストおよびプロジェクト全体の開発効率を向上させる。 業界で優れた自動化テストツール・プラットフォームの導入・構築を担当し、全体のデリバリー品質を高める。
5. 有効な評価モデルおよび評価方法を構築し、業務の特徴に基づいて定量的な分析を実施します。
1、负责分析产品需求、架构，设计测试方法和测试用例；
2、负责产品功能、系统性能、平台兼容性、API接口测试等测试工作，在产品运营过程中发现、收集、暴露质量问题并推动和跟踪问题的解决；
3、负责同类产品分析、稳定性分析、系统可靠性等专项测试工作，对具体的测试活动进行规划实施；
４、负责规划游戏产品的自动化和持续集成建设，提升测试和项目工程效率。负责行业优秀自动化测试工具平台的引入及搭建，提升整体交付质量；
5、负责构建有效的评估模型和评估方法，结合业务特点进行量化分析。

応募資格/Who We Look For
1. コンピュータソフトウェア関連の学士号以上を有していること
2. 論理的思考力に優れ、良好なコミュニケーション・調整力、推進力を備えていること
3. ソフトウェア工学の基礎知識を有し、ソフトウェアテストに関する理論や手法に精通していること
4. コンピュータに関する理論的基礎がしっかりしており、オペレーティングシステムやネットワークの基本原理を熟知していること
5. 卓越を追求し、細部まで注意を払えること。ユーザー視点に立って物事を考える姿勢を持ち、原則を守り、優れた学習能力と独立した思考習慣を備えていること
【歓迎条件】
1. 1種類以上のプログラミング言語に精通している方
2. コーディング能力に優れ、各種デバッグツールの使用経験がある方
1、计算机软件相关专业本科或及以上学历；

Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.

Tencent Games Global Data Insight is a world-class data science team empowering game development, publishing, and operations across our global portfolio. Leverage large-scale data to uncover insights, guide decision-making, and drive measurable business impact across R&D, marketing, and live-ops stages.
Build computational workflows using Python, SQL, and big-data ecosystems to process and analyze complex datasets.
Design and deploy scalable, automated frameworks for A/B testing, statistical modeling, and machine learning.
Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to design end-to-end data solutions that optimize player experience, monetization, and operational efficiency.
Contribute to a culture of experimentation and scientific rigor through analytics innovation, reproducibility, and continuous learning.

Ph.D in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Deep understanding of mathematical modeling, statistical inference, and machine learning techniques applied to real-world data.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) is a plus.
Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights and communicate findings effectively to non-technical audiences.
Passion for gaming and enthusiasm for using data to improve player engagement and business outcomes.

Innovation & Growth: Collaborate with world-class experts across data science, game design, and AI research.

Global Opportunities: Work with teams across Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Palo Alto — where data meets global gaming innovation.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容 
１、ゲーム内のサウンドシステム開発 リアルタイムオーディオシステム、音声再生制御、環境音処理、7.1.4 Dolby Atmos対応3Dサウンド機能など、ゲーム体験を強化する音響システムをディレクターや実機の要件を元に設計・実装します。
２、ミドルウェア（Wwise/ADX2等）のUE5への組み込みと独自カスタマイズ オーディオミドルウェアを活用し、UE5との連携・拡張機能の開発・実装を担当します。
３、サウンドデザイナーとの連携とツール開発 サウンドデザイナーが効率よく実装・調整できるように、オーディオエディタやデバッグツールの開発・保守を行います。
４、サウンドデータの最適化 ハードウェアリソースやパフォーマンスを考慮し、メモリ管理、音声データ・ストリーミング処理の設計および最適化を行います。 ５、オーディオイベントの制御実装 ゲームプレイに連動したサウンドイベントの制御や、キャラクター・UI・環境音など多岐にわたるオーディオ制御ロジックを設計、実装します。
６、プロシージャルオーディオの研究開発 社内技研との協力のもと、AI等駆使しつつUE5でのプロシージャルオーディオエンジンの設計・実装
７、ペリフェラルの振動設計および実装
Job Description
・In-game sound system development Design and implement audio systems that enhance the game experience—such as real-time audio systems, sound playback control, environmental sound processing, and 7.1.4 Dolby Atmos–compatible 3D sound—based on director instructions and hardware requirements.
・Middleware (Wwise / ADX2, etc.) integration into UE5 with custom extensions Utilize audio middleware to handle UE5 integration, develop extended features, and perform custom implementations.
・Collaboration with sound designers and tool development Develop and maintain audio editors and debugging tools to help sound designers efficiently implement and fine-tune audio assets.
・Sound data optimization Optimize memory usage, design streaming and audio data processing, and improve performance with hardware resource constraints in mind.
・Audio event control implementation Design and implement control logic for sound events tied to gameplay, including character sounds, UI audio, environmental sounds, and other diverse audio categories.
・Procedural audio research and development In collaboration with the company’s R&D division, design and implement procedural audio engines for UE5, leveraging AI and other advanced techniques.
・Peripheral vibration design and implementation

応募条件
・サウンドプログラマーまたはゲームプログラマーとしての実務経験
・C++やC#などのプログラミングスキル ・オーディオミドルウェア（Wwise、ADX2等）を使用した開発経験
・サウンドデザイナーとの協業経験、またはそれに準ずる理解
・コンソールまたはPCにてAA以上のタイトル開発経験
・UE5実装知識 歓迎スキル
・マルチプラットフォーム（家庭用ゲーム機・PC・モバイル）向けのサウンド開発経験
・リアルタイムサウンド処理、DSPや音響プラグイン制作の専門知識
・DAWやオーディオツールに関する技術的理解およびスクリプト制作
・波形解析知識
Qualifications
・Professional experience as a sound programmer or game programmer
・Programming skills in C++ and/or C#
・Experience developing with audio middleware (Wwise, ADX2, etc.)
・Experience collaborating with sound designers, or equivalent understanding
・Development experience on console or PC titles at AA scale or above
・Working knowledge of UE5 implementation Preferred Skills
・Experience in audio development for multiple platforms (consoles, PC, mobile)
・Expertise in real-time audio processing, DSP, and audio plugin development
・Technical understanding of DAWs and audio tools, including script creation

原作や脚本と連携し、テキストベースの情報をゲーム体験としてどのように実装するか設計します。選択肢、分岐、演出、テンポなどを総合的に調整します。
・イベント演出・カメラ・アニメーションの設計指示
会話イベント中の演出（カメラワーク、モーション、SE、UI表示など）を指定し、シナリオの感情や意図をより魅力的に伝える演出を設計します。
・アドベンチャーUI/UXの設計
選択肢の見せ方、ログ表示、スキップ／巻き戻し、探索時のインタラクションなど、プレイヤーが快適に物語を楽しめるUI/UXを設計します。

・Adventure UI/UX Design Design user interfaces and interactions—such as choice selection, log display, skip/rewind functions, and exploration interactions—that allow players to comfortably enjoy the narrative.
・Implementation, Testing, and Polish Implement designed specifications in the game engine, conduct iterative testing during development, and refine the user experience through repeated adjustments.

・テキスト・シナリオをゲーム体験に落とし込むための論理的な設計力

・ゲームエンジンやスクリプトを使った実装・検証経験
・チームと連携できるコミュニケーション力とドキュメント作成能力

・Strong logical design ability to adapt text/scenarios into gameplay
・Understanding and practical experience in UI/UX design

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1.戦闘システムの設計
攻撃、回避、防御、スキルの使用といった基本的な戦闘メカニクスをデザインし、プレイヤーにとって心地よい操作性とバランスを実現します。
2.敵キャラクターおよびボスのデザイン
敵の動きや攻撃パターン、特性を設定し、プレイヤーにとっての挑戦と達成感を考慮したバトル体験を提供します。ボス戦における戦略的な要素やエキサイティングな演出も企画します。
3.バトルバランスの調整
プレイヤーのスキルや装備に応じて適切なバランスを維持し、ゲームの難易度が適度に保たれるよう、数値や敵の配置を調整します。
4.プレイテストとフィードバック分析
戦闘の快適さ、爽快感、戦略性が維持されているかをテストし、プレイヤーのフィードバックを基にバトルの改善・調整を行います。
5.仕様書やデザイン資料の作成
戦闘システムの仕様書やデザインに関するドキュメントを作成し、他部門が理解できるように情報を整理して伝えます
Job Description
1. Designing Combat Systems
- Design fundamental combat mechanics such as attacks, dodges, defense, and skill usage to ensure smooth gameplay and balance for the player.
2. Designing Enemy Characters and Bosses
- Create enemy movements, attack patterns, and characteristics to provide a challenging and rewarding battle experience for players. Plan strategic elements and exciting features for boss battles.
3. Adjusting Battle Balance
- Maintain appropriate balance according to the player’s skills and equipment, ensuring the game’s difficulty remains fair by adjusting numbers and enemy placement.
4. Playtesting and Feedback Analysis
- Test the comfort, excitement, and strategic nature of combat and make improvements and adjustments based on player feedback.
5. Creating Specifications and Design Documents
- Prepare documents detailing the specifications of combat systems and related designs, organizing and communicating information clearly to other departments.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募資格
アクションゲームやAAAタイトルにおけるコンバットデザインの経験（優遇）
敵の動作や攻撃パターンに関する知識、およびAI設計のスキル
プレイテストや数値調整を通じてバトルバランスを取る能力
戦闘システムや敵デザインに関する詳細な資料や仕様書を作成する能力
プログラムおよびアニメーションの基礎知識がある方（尚可）
明確で詳細なドキュメントを作成する能力
Qualifications
- Experience in combat design for action games or AAA titles (preferred)
- Knowledge of enemy movements and attack patterns, along with AI design skills
- Ability to balance battles through playtesting and numerical adjustments
- Ability to create detailed documentation and specifications related to combat systems and enemy design
- Basic knowledge of programming and animation (preferred)
- Ability to create clear and detailed documentation

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1. 物語およびキャラクター設定の構築
ゲームのストーリー全体やキャラクターの背景、個性を設計し、物語のテーマやメッセージを明確にします。
2. シーンやイベントのデザイン
ゲーム内のカットシーンやイベントシーンの演出を企画し、物語の展開を支えるシーンを細かくデザインします。プレイヤーが物語に没入できるよう、感動的なシナリオを描きます。
3. 台詞およびテキストの執筆
キャラクターの台詞やナレーション、プレイヤーが出会うテキストの執筆を担当し、キャラクターの個性や物語の進行を効果的に表現します。
4. 分岐ストーリーおよびインタラクションの設計
プレイヤーの選択や行動がストーリーに影響を与える分岐や選択肢を設計し、プレイヤーの没入感を高めます。
5. 他部門との連携
アート、アニメーション、サウンドなどの他部門と協力し、ナラティブ要素が視覚的、聴覚的に伝わるよう調整します。シーンの演出やカットシーンに合わせたストーリー構成を実現します。

1. Story and Character Development
- Design the overall game story, character backgrounds, and personalities, clarifying the themes and messages of the narrative.
2. Scene and Event Design
- Plan and design the direction of in-game cutscenes and event scenes, supporting story progression with detailed and impactful scenes to enhance player immersion and create emotional scenarios.
3. Dialogue and Text Writing
- Responsible for writing character dialogues, narration, and in-game text that players encounter, effectively conveying character traits and advancing the story. 4. Design of Branching Stories and Interactions
- Create branching storylines and choices that are influenced by player decisions and actions, increasing player engagement and immersion.
5. Collaboration with Other Departments
- Work closely with departments such as art, animation, and sound to ensure that narrative elements are conveyed visually and audibly, aligning the story structure with scene direction and cutscenes.

Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1. テンセントLighSpeedスタジオの次世代コンソールゲームプロジェクトにおいて、製品特性に適した音声デザインおよび実施プランを策定する。
2.音声デザインの計画に基づき、要件の調整、リソースの制作および統合、テスト検証と最適化を行い、ゲームの最終的なサウンド品質を管理する。
Job Description
1. Formulate sound design and implementation plans suitable for product features for Tencent LightSpeed Studio's next-generation console game projects.
2. Based on the sound design plan, coordinate requirements, create and integrate resources, conduct testing and optimization, and manage the final sound quality of the game.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募資格
1.5年以上のゲーム音声制作経験があり、AAAクオリティの高品質ゲーム音声デザインにフルタイムで参加経験があること。ゲーム音声制作の全体フローに精通。
2.高いサウンドデザイン能力を持ち、音声録音、処理、ミキシングを効率よく行える。DAWソフト（Digital Audio Workstation）を1つ以上使いこなすことができ、エフェクターやシンセサイザーなどの音響設計ツールの実用的なスキルを有する。
3.サウンドデザインとパイプライン構築能力に優れ、Wwiseなどの音声ミドルウェアを使いこなせる。UnityやUEなどのゲームエンジンの基本操作に精通している。
4.日本語必須、英語か中国語でコミュニケーションできる方大歓迎。
5.プロジェクト管理スキルがあり、チーム内外で調整してニーズを期限内に確実に実行できる。
6.熱心なゲーマーで、ゲームとゲーム音声に対する情熱を持ち、ゲームプレイと音声デザインの関係について独自の理解がある。
7.独立してプロジェクトを進める能力と、チームで協力して仕事を進める能力の両方があり、学習能力とチームワークを重視する。
Requirements
1. Over 5 years of experience in game sound production, with full-time participation in high-quality, AAA-standard game sound design, and a comprehensive understanding of the entire game sound production process.
2. Strong sound design skills, including efficient audio recording, processing, and mixing capabilities. Proficiency in using at least one DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) software and practical skills in sound design tools such as effects processors and synthesizers.
3. Excellent abilities in sound design and pipeline construction, with proficiency in audio middleware such as Wwise. Familiarity with basic operations of game engines such as Unity and Unreal Engine (UE).
4. Japanese fluency is required; candidates who can communicate in English or Chinese are highly welcomed.
5. Project management skills with the ability to coordinate within and outside the team to meet needs on time.
6. A passionate gamer with a deep interest in game sound and a unique understanding of the relationship between gameplay and sound design.
7. The ability to independently lead projects and work collaboratively as part of a team, with a focus on learning and teamwork.

1. 製品の要件やアーキテクチャを分析し、テスト方法およびテストケースの設計を担当します。
2. 製品の機能、システム性能、プラットフォームの互換性、APIインターフェースのテストなどのテスト業務を担当し、製品運用中に品質問題を発見、収集、明確化し、それらの解決を推進および追跡します。
3. 同種製品の分析、安定性分析、システム信頼性などの特定テスト業務を担当し、具体的なテスト活動の計画と実施を行います。
4. ゲーム製品における自動化および継続的インテグレーション（CI）の構築を企画・推進し、テストおよびプロジェクト全体の開発効率を向上させる。 業界で優れた自動化テストツール・プラットフォームの導入・構築を担当し、全体のデリバリー品質を高める。

４、负责规划游戏产品的自动化和持续集成建设，提升测试和项目工程效率。负责行业优秀自动化测试工具平台的引入及搭建，提升整体交付质量；
5、负责构建有效的评估模型和评估方法，结合业务特点进行量化分析。

4. コンピュータに関する理論的基礎がしっかりしており、オペレーティングシステムやネットワークの基本原理を熟知していること
